crossRefs.note: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

translations.web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
translations.bsb: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
translations.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
translations.asv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
